about: The skills map: which skills a brief names for which job. Names only, never a skill's text (paid skills stay on the machine). Each fallback is the kit's own one-line advice for a model without skills. The rulebook's Skills map section explains it; a project adds or removes names with "skills": { "add": [...], "remove": [...] } in scripts/agents/kit.json.

sets.name: ui-review
sets.why: UI review (kit review on a UI diff, and kit ux)

caveman.label: Short talk
caveman.fallback: Telegraphic messages to other agents; exact paths, commands and numbers.

good-css.label: CSS
good-css.fallback: Reach for current CSS (grid, custom properties, container queries, :has) before extra markup, media-query stacks or script.

emil-design-foundations.label: Design
emil-design-foundations.fallback: Treat hierarchy, spacing, type and colour as one system, and design the empty, error and busy states too.

emil-ui-polish.label: Polish
emil-ui-polish.fallback: Finish the details: alignment, even spacing, hover, focus and pressed states, nothing stray.

emil-forms-and-inputs.label: Forms
emil-forms-and-inputs.fallback: Every field has a label and a clear focus ring, errors sit beside the field, and a submit cannot fire twice.

emil-typography.label: Type
emil-typography.fallback: A small type scale, comfortable line length and line height, steady weights.

emil-color.label: Colour
emil-color.fallback: Use the theme's colour tokens, check text contrast, and keep dark mode in step.

emil-surfaces.label: Surfaces
emil-surfaces.fallback: Menus, popovers and dialogs open by their trigger, close on Escape and outside click, and hold focus while open.

emil-touch-and-accessibility.label: Touch and access
emil-touch-and-accessibility.fallback: Big enough targets, everything reachable by keyboard, visible focus, names for screen readers.

emil-mobile-native.label: Phones
emil-mobile-native.fallback: On a phone: no hover-only actions, room for the notch and home bar, no zoom when a field gets focus.

emil-animations.label: Motion
emil-animations.fallback: Move things only to explain a change: short, eased out, transform and opacity, and none when reduced motion is asked.

animate.label: Motion choices
animate.fallback: First ask whether it should move at all; then match duration and easing to the size of the change.

emil-performance.label: Speed
emil-performance.fallback: Keep the main thread free: no layout thrash, load heavy parts late, never transition every property.

emil-component-design.label: Component APIs
emil-component-design.fallback: Small composable components with good defaults, not piles of boolean props.

emil-design-system-docs.label: Design system docs
emil-design-system-docs.fallback: Write down which component and token to use where, from the code that exists.

emil-marketing-pages.label: Marketing pages
emil-marketing-pages.fallback: Fast pages with real content first, little motion and one clear call to action.

emil-ui-review.label: UI review
emil-ui-review.fallback: Check the UI diff for spacing, states, motion and accessibility slips, each with its fix.

emil-unslop-design.label: Generic design
emil-unslop-design.fallback: Name design choices that look like a template, and say the specific one instead.

break-ui.label: Worst case
break-ui.fallback: Feed the UI worst-case data (long names, empty lists, huge numbers, other scripts) and report what breaks.

emil-prep-for-prod.label: Before release
emil-prep-for-prod.fallback: Before going live, check page metadata, error and loading states, accessibility and speed.
